question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**as**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage refers to the concept of democracy.
 
• **Now, in blank 5 the blank will draw a comparison or relation between "democracy" and "political system."**
 
• **Thus, among the given options, the correct word to use in the blank is "as."** 
 
 
• "As" is used to indicate a comparison or similarity between two things.
 
• Example: "He ran as fast as he could."
 
 
 
• In this case, the blank is likely followed by a phrase that is being compared to the subject of the sentence.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, "of", is a preposition that is often used to show possession or relationship between two things. Example: "The book of my friend."
 
• Option 3, "over", is a preposition that can indicate a physical position above something or a figurative sense of control or influence. Example: "The bird flew over the house."
 
• Option 4, "in", is a preposition that can indicate location or time. Example: "He was born in 1990."
